Oxygen environments include a four-coordinate O site with two La and two Mn neighbors and a three-coordinate O site with three Mn neighbors. The Mn octahedra share edges with one another, and La polyhedra share corners, edges, and faces with Mn octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
